flags.why: Calling someone cu li in this sense is derogatory, even though speakers also use it about themselves.
Nhũ mẫu means a wet nurse, whereas nanny includes caregivers who do not breastfeed the child.
flags.fix: wet nurse (a woman employed to breastfeed another woman's child)

flags.why: The common sense meaning paltry or meagre, as in đồng lương còm, is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%C3%B2m)).
flags.fix: adj [colloquial] | paltry; meagre (of money or earnings)

flags.why: In sports, hiểm hóc describes something difficult for an opponent to counter, rather than generally bold or impressive ([example usage](https://thethao.vtv.vn/ngoai-hang-anh/lacazette-xu-tinh-te-go-hoa-cho-arsenal-truoc-liverpool-20181104022421323.htm)).
flags.fix: tricky; difficult to counter or stop (of a shot or move in sports)

flags.why: Really impressive omits the move's difficulty for the opponent, which is what hiểm hóc conveys.
flags.fix: That move was really difficult to counter!

flags.why: Giỏi denotes an excellent academic rating here, so translating it as good understates the stated grade.
flags.fix: Her academic performance is rated excellent.
